title: Quant-fidelity sweeper: integrate INT8 weight-only calibration and acceptance harness
creator: Maya Singh
description:
Goal: Build and integrate a reproducible acceptance harness (the 'fidelity sweeper') that automates calibration, metric collection, and rollback gating for INT8 weight-only transforms (GPTQ/AWQ variants). This ticket covers the end-to-end pipeline glue: invoking quantizers, running a compact evaluation corpus, collecting token-level and sequence-level deltas vs FP16 baseline, and surfacing pass/fail results to CI and the Console.

Why: current INT8 merges and calibration steps are manual and fragmented across repos. We need an automated, low-latency feedback loop so we can safely roll new quant profiles and detect accuracy regressions before promoting to Dedicated and Hosted fleets.

Success criteria (acceptance):
- A reproducible pipeline that runs in CI and nightly job invoking both GPTQ and AWQ weight-only calibration on a supplied model bundle.
- For each run, compute: perplexity delta, answer F1 on QA subset, token-level logprob RMSE, and a per-prompt confidence delta.
- Define and apply pass/fail thresholds (configurable per-model) to gate promotion; failing runs produce a synthesized report and a suggested rollback tag.
- Generated artifacts (calibration profiles, metrics, diffs) uploaded to S3 and linked into the Console test dashboard.
- Integrates with canary harness: if nightly fails, create ENG issue + alert to #quant-infra.

Approach:
1) Implement a small orchestrator (Python) that sequences: model download, weight-only quantizer invocation (GPTQ and AWQ cli), calibration metadata capture, quick-eval runner against 200 curated prompts, and artifact upload.
2) Reuse the existing small-eval corpus from research/evals and add an 'edge cases' subset emphasising numeric stability and long prompt context.
3) Add a lightweight adapter that computes the pass/fail signal and writes a machine-readable verdict used by CI + the Console.
4) Add CI job to runtime repo (linux-gpu runner) and a scheduled nightly pipeline that exercises the top-5 models in the catalog.

Acceptance testing: run pipeline locally on dev GPU, land infra changes behind feature flag, and run nightly for one week with strict monitoring.

Non-goals: full-blown long-run accuracy sweep across all models (that is follow-up), and automated rollback automation beyond creating the issue and suggested tag.
tasks: Wire GPTQ/AWQ invocations and standardize their output format
Implement quick-eval runner and metrics collectors
Upload artifacts + link to Console test dashboard
Add CI job and nightly schedule
Define per-model threshold config and policy
